description: Prepare a borrow on a Morpho Blue market. Returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with the borrow tx. Includes health factor check against existing collateral position. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions.

borrowAmount.description: Loan token amount to borrow in human-readable decimals (e.g., "500"), or "max" for maximum borrowable
